ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, what is grass?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, there is a cluster of green plants labeled "grasses" in the middle at the bottom. In the diagram there are arrows from these grasses pointing to the animal consumer area above, such as grouse, marmots, etc., indicating that the grasses are eaten by animals. Reasoning: The question asks what grasses are in this food web. Grasses are plants, can make their own food through photosynthesis, and are the basic source of energy in the food web, so the ecological role of grasses is producers.
